$schema_note: Starter shape for ONE approved inside-group Community calendar task consumed by scripts/community_publish.py. This is input to Skill 35, not a provider payload: community_publish.py builds the provider request (accountIds + communityPostDetails.postAsUser) from it and refuses anything it cannot prove. `group_id` must be the observed backend group id, never a portal slug. Every listed account gets its OWN author; a member eligible in one private channel is not assumed eligible in another. `notify_all_group_members` defaults to false and requires explicit broadcast approval.
title: Approved discussion title
caption: Approved discussion content. Community captions run to 100,000 characters, so this text is never truncated to fit a shorter channel on the same cycle.
_notes: community-channels.json is the runtime limit table; title <= 1000, caption <= 100000, media <= 4, comment <= 8000.
A reply/conversation intent belongs to Skill 38 and is refused here (conversation_owned_by_skill_38).
A new group/channel needs the managed re-sync step before it has an account id; the account is re-queried afterwards.
